title: "Comparable glycan fingerprints"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Comparable glycan fingerprints}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
```

```{r}
library(glyfp)
a <- c("Galb3Galb3Galb-", "Galb-")
b <- c("Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-", NA_character_)
```

`glycan_fingerprint()` fits on the current batch and returns only a list of
vectors. For joint comparison combine the batches before fitting:

```{r}
all_fp <- glycan_fingerprint(c(a, b), "substructure_count")
lengths(all_fp)
```

Independent calls do not define a shared space, even at equal lengths:

```{r}
glycan_fingerprint("Gal(b1-")
glycan_fingerprint("Man(a1-")
```

For repeated batches, retain one encoder. In model evaluation, fit it using
training data only, then transform held-out data.

```{r}
encoder <- fit_fingerprint(a, "substructure_count", max_size=2)
fp_a <- transform_fingerprint(a, encoder)
fp_b <- transform_fingerprint(b, encoder)
stopifnot(identical(names(fp_a[[1]]), names(fp_b[[1]])))
stopifnot(all(is.na(fp_b[[2]])))
```

Text parsing is delegated to glyparse; structure objects produce the same values.

```{r}
objects <- glyparse::auto_parse(a)
stopifnot(identical(transform_fingerprint(objects, encoder), fp_a))
```

Overlap is counted: the Gal-Gal motif occurs twice in the chain of three Gal
residues. Branch permutations of a single occurrence do not multiply its count.

```{r}
fp_a[[1]]
symmetric <- "Gal(b1-?)[Gal(b1-?)]GlcNAc(b1-"
glycan_fingerprint(symmetric, "substructure_count")
```

Unknown canonical motifs never append columns. Known generic or ambiguous motifs
can still match more specific input under glymotif's strict semantics.

```{r}
generic <- fit_fingerprint("Hex(?1-", "substructure_count")
transform_fingerprint("Gal(b1-", generic)
```

Use `unknown="warn"` or `unknown="error"` while fitting to detect novel canonical
motifs at transformation. Missing values propagate unless `na_action="error"`.
An encoder fitted on empty/all-NA input has no features, so a length-zero vector
cannot carry missingness; keep the original missing-value mask in that case.

```{r}
empty <- fit_fingerprint(character())
transform_fingerprint(c("Gal(b1-", NA_character_), empty)
```

The encoder can be serialized without graph pointers. Preserve the recorded
versions of glyrepr, glymotif and glyparse when reusing it in another session.

```{r}
path <- tempfile(fileext=".rds")
saveRDS(encoder, path)
stopifnot(identical(transform_fingerprint(a, readRDS(path)), fp_a))
unlink(path)
```
